units.en: well well well it seems congratulations are in order you finished the class I want to thank you for sticking with it and joining me as you learn this interesting skill but I also want to remind you of what I said at the beginning of the class when you're done with the class you're not actually done there's so much more training and practice which is necessary to truly master this skill now hopefully you'll be able to get some of this practice via the subsequent classes which build on

this material and it's ultimately my desire that you get a job in this area which lets you utilize these skills on a regular basis until then though I want to encourage you to keep leveling up keep learning those mad skills and climbing the skills tree because the more tools that you have in your toolbox the better engineer that you'll be
